title: Template card props (props.card of every ext_template scene)

title.description: The beat's headline: the one idea of the beat in at most 5 words. Fits 900 px at 64-132 px.

lines.description: Up to three short lines that land on their words; each fits one line at 58 px.

lineAt.description: Frame of the scene (from its start) on which each line appears: one per line, rising.

palette.description: The card's colours: ink (dark), paper (light) or signal (navy). Keep one palette per video.
